This page is a list of all characters, in the books or mentioned, who have been cut off from or otherwise lost the ability to touch the [[One Power|True Source]] or [[Severing|Severed]]. This would include women who have been [[Stilled]], Men who have been [[Severing|Gentled]], and those who have been [[Severing|Burned Out]].
